gizmo.title: Diagram from text
gizmo.description: Write a diagram as text (Mermaid): a flowchart, sequence, timeline and more. It is drawn in the page with a text alternative.

configure.title: Title
configure.description: Shown above the diagram and used as its name.

configure.title: Diagram source
configure.description: Mermaid text, for example: flowchart TD, then one line per link such as A[Draft] --> B{Ready?}. Add |label| after an arrow to label it. The drawing updates as you type.

configure.title: Text alternative
configure.description: Describe what the diagram shows for people who cannot see it. Leave empty on a flowchart to have its steps listed for you.

configure.title: Caption
configure.description: Optional caption shown below the diagram.

configure.title: Show the source
configure.description: Show the diagram text next to the drawing.

configure.title: Show the text alternative
configure.description: Show the text alternative below the drawing. It is always available to screen readers.

advanced.title: Source file
advanced.description: Address of a .mmd file to draw instead of the text above (https or a path on this site).

advanced.title: Accent color
advanced.description: Color of the icon chip in the header.

demoSchema.content:
flowchart TD
  A[Draft the page] --> B{Has media?}
  B -->|Yes| C[Add captions and alt text]
  B -->|No| D[Run the a11y audit]
  C --> D
  D --> E((Publish))
